page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u2a-c1m2.4xlarge is an x86_64 cloud server instance managed under the KVM hypervisor. The hardware profile includes 16 dedicated AMD EPYC virtual cores operating at a base clock speed of 2.25 GHz. It is provisioned with 32.0 GB of system memory, which yields a ratio of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Hardware GPU acceleration is not present in this configuration.

Storage and networking capabilities rely on cloud-attached infrastructure. The instance features no local disk storage, requiring network-attached block storage for system images and persistent data persistence. Network connectivity provides a baseline bandwidth capacity of 6 Gbps, and the server includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The 1:2 compute-to-memory ratio prioritizes core density over memory volume. This profile provides dedicated CPU resource utilization for tasks where high RAM capacities are unnecessary. Consequently, this server is suitable for CPU-bound batch processing, compilation workloads, continuous integration pipelines, and compute-focused backend services.
